value.account:
CHANGED. State/selection: RunState.result_persistence_profile (+validation at construction/initialize/load, additive, omitted when absent); initialize(..., result_persistence_profile=); `orchestrator run` and `resume --force-restart` select the profile for .orc; _CallFrameStateManager takes the profile only for fresh frames and calls.py selects it from callee provenance (frontend_kind == workflow_lisp), only when the frame is fresh and not iteration-owned; load_existing_call_frame_read_only plus a malformed-existing-frame ValueError before any write. New modules: pure_replay_core (error, witness, shell, classifier, atomic apply_* transitions), pure_replay_index (PureResultReplayIndex, literal/ref document walker, multi-visit analysis, _propagate_pure_ineligibility), pure_replay_runtime (PureReplayRuntime: witness, cache with revalidation against durable shell/active result, replay_node, overlay, boundary audit, persisted-surface audit), pure_replay_executor (executor coordinator), pure_result_replay (re-export surface), lexical_checkpoint_profile. StateManager and the call-frame manager gained begin/reuse/settle methods; OutcomeRecorder.persist_step_result takes eligible_pure_settlement. Executor: visit opened before guards for eligible nodes (so skips/failures are full rows with a visit), pure evaluation runs without bundle surfaces, preflight (surface conflicts, then progress witnesses) before the prologue, boundary replay before the default-resume decision; restart node is determined once and passed to ResumePlanner.determine_default_resume_decision(restart_node_id=...); provider observation manager is now created at execute() start (I updated three existing tests in test_provider_observation_workflow.py that asserted creation at construction). Checkpoints: emit_runtime_shadow_record skips eligible points, capture_restore_payload drops bindings sourced from eligible steps, default resume filters eligible points before nearest selection and adds the VALIDATED_FRAME_ENTRY_REPLAY zero-record case (fail closed with prior_boundary_not_restorable when leaves/witnesses do not validate). Docs: new section in specs/state.md. Tests: tests/test_derived_pure_replay_profile.py + tests/pure_replay_helpers.py (real compile and executor runs, resume surgery, CLI run/force-restart, child frames, default resume).

ALTERNATIVES. Putting everything in one pure_result_replay.py (rejected: >500-line module guideline; split into core/index/runtime and re-export). Detecting iteration-owned frames via a new flag threaded from loops (rejected as invasive; I use runtime_step_id != static step id, which is a heuristic). Opening the pure visit at the old increment/start_step site (rejected: skip/failed rows would then lack a visit and fail classification). Making the active run re-read pure values from the durable state (rejected: shells carry no values, so the in-memory state keeps the full finalized row and the cache is revalidated against it). Mocks avoided except one monkeypatch to count determine_restart_node_id calls.

NOT COVERED / RISKS. Several interface details were underspecified and are my guesses: PureBinding.path is a dotted/bracket string; scope mismatch reports expected_scope=<argument>, actual_scope="root"; resolve_bundle_path is called with the PureNode; reachability_ambiguous is raised when a needed pure dependency was not reached; step-id vs node-id distinction relies on the bundle (in compiled bundles they are equal, so node_id_for_step_id(raw node id) returns the node there). Seed discovery for boundary replay scans repr() of downstream nodes for the node id or root.steps ref (over-approximate, harmless extra replay). Loop-owned/recurrent detection uses runtime-plan nested bodies and back-edge routes only. Pure nodes with publishes/consumes are treated as ineligible (artifact_lineage). profile_conflict is raised (not written to state) from execute(); other replay failures become failed-run errors. The restorable-prior-boundary default-resume case (validated_prior_boundary with RESTORED) is not covered by a test because synthetic plans break the semantic digest; only the non-restorable branch and the zero-record branch are tested. Checkpoint-record/restore_payload conflict detection reads sidecar indexes but has no dedicated test. The state-transition methods for child frames go through _mutate_scoped_state and are exercised only indirectly (child-frame run test). No docs/plans file was written. Full suite: 157 failures, all identical to the unmodified HEAD baseline (provider-isolation/materialization socket tests and similar environment-bound tests) plus one flaky test that passes alone; no new regressions.
value.summary: Added the derived_pure_replay.v1 profile end to end: state selector and CLI/child-frame selection, replay index, value-free shells with atomic visit transactions, resume-time in-memory replay, checkpoint filtering, the zero-record default-resume case, single restart-boundary determination and lazy observation manager; 57 new tests pass and the full suite shows no new failures.
